srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.body: This album, released in 2008, became one of the most controversial albums of the year, not for its content, but for its sound quality. It is cited as a prime example of the "Loudness Wars" due to excessive compression, which resulted in a lack of dynamic range and perceived distortion, even at low volumes. Fans launched online petitions demanding the band re-do the album. "Not for what it says or what the band has done, but for the way the album sounds."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
